DateOnly.FromDateTime(d.Created.UtcDateTime); /// <summary>Mutasi yang tercatat di satu dokumen (dari nilai yang dikunci saat submit).</summary> public static IEnumerable<Movement> Extract(Document doc) { var d = doc.Data; var date = DateOf(doc); Movement Mv(string? item, string? wh, decimal qty, decimal value) => new(item ?? "", wh ?? "", date, doc.Created, doc.DocType, doc.Name, qty, value); switch (doc.DocType) { case "StockEntry": var purpose = d.Str("purpose"); foreach (var r in d.Rows("items")) { var s = purpose == "Material Receipt" ? null : r.Str("s_warehouse") ?? d.Str("from_warehouse"); var t = purpose == "Material Issue" ? null : r.Str("t_warehouse") ?? d.Str("to_warehouse"); if (s is not null) yield return Mv(r.Str("item"), s, -r.Dec("qty"), -r.Dec("amount")); if (t is not null) yield return Mv(r.Str("item"), t, r.Dec("qty"), r.Dec("amount")); } break; case "GoodsReceipt": foreach (var r in d.Rows("items").Where(r => r.Bool("is_stock_item"))) yield return Mv(r.Str("item"), d.Str("warehouse"), r.Dec("received_qty"), r.Dec("amount")); break; case "SalesInvoice": case "SalesCreditNote": case "PurchaseInvoice": if (!d.Bool("update_stock")) break; var sign = doc.DocType == "SalesInvoice" ? -1m : 1m; foreach (var r in d.Rows("items").Where(HasStock)) yield return Mv(r.Str("item"), d.Str("warehouse"), sign * r.Dec("qty"), sign * r.Dec("stock_amount")); break; case "StockReconciliation": foreach (var r in d.Rows("items")) yield return Mv(r.Str("item"), d.Str("warehouse"), r.Dec("qty_difference"), r.Dec("amount_difference")); break; } } /// <summary>Semua mutasi dari dokumen submit (kecuali satu dokumen), urut tanggal lalu waktu dibuat.</summary> public static async Task<List<Movement>> AllAsync(Masters m, string? exceptType, string? exceptName, CancellationToken ct) { var all = new List<Movement>(); foreach (var type in Sources) { IReadOnlyList<FilterClause> filter = type is "SalesInvoice" or "SalesCreditNote" or "PurchaseInvoice" ? [new FilterClause("update_stock", "=", true)] : []; foreach (var doc in await m.QueryAsync(type, filter, ct, take: 200_000)) if (doc.DocStatus == DocStatus.Submitted && !(doc.DocType == exceptType && doc.Name == exceptName)) all.AddRange(Extract(doc)); } return all.Where(x => x.Item != "" && x.Warehouse != "").OrderBy(x => x.Date).ThenBy(x => x.Created).ToList(); } public static Dictionary<(string Item, string Wh), Bin> Bins(IEnumerable<Movement> moves, DateOnly? asOf = null) { var bins = new Dictionary<(string, string), Bin>(); foreach (var x in moves.Where(x => asOf is null || x.Date <= asOf)) { if (!bins.TryGetValue((x.Item, x.Warehouse), out var b)) bins[(x.Item, x.Warehouse)] = b = new Bin(); b.Qty += x.Qty; b.Value += x.Value; if (x.Date > b.LastDate) b.LastDate = x.Date; } return bins; } public static async Task<IDictionary<string, object?>> SettingsAsync(Masters m, CancellationToken ct) => await m.SingleAsync("StockSettings", ct); public static async Task<string> InventoryAccountAsync(Masters m, string warehouse, CancellationToken ct) => await m.StrAsync("Warehouse", warehouse, "inventory_account", ct) ??
